About Klyq

Klyq is a social app for adults (18+) to meet, chat and connect with people nearby. People create a profile, discover others around them, and talk one-to-one or in groups — moving to voice or video calls only once both people agree to connect.

Calquors built Klyq for Android and publishes it on Google Play, with safety built in from the start: visibility controls, blocking and reporting.

Features

  • Discover people nearby
  • One-to-one and group chat
  • Status updates
  • Voice and video calls once both people agree
  • Visibility controls, blocking and reporting
  • Klyq Plus: an optional subscription that removes ads and adds extra filters
